_comment: Project-scope (per-install) source-fetched skills. SETUP fetches each entry from its canonical public repo at install (always latest). Single source of truth — the blueprint never holds a copy of these registry skills that can silently drift. Refresh/export MUST NOT re-vendor these entries; it only maintains this list. The separately bundled legal reference shelf lives under templates/project/skills/legal/ and stays project-scope. Machine-scope (host-global) skills — ghostwriter, vision-factory, and the deep-rr in-tree pointer — moved to templates/global/skills/sources.json; this file carries none of them. What used to ship as standalone reasoning skills now ships as commands: quality:prompt and quality:doc are global (templates/global/commands/); rnd, wave:refine, wave:walker, audit:code-hygiene and audit:security are project-scope (templates/project/commands/), each registering via its frontmatter name.
